description: This file is a Smarty plugin implementing a block function called 'textformat' which formats text blocks with customizable styles, indentations, and wrapping options. It provides functionality to reformat text with specific styles such as email formatting, wrapping, and indentation within Smarty templates.

methods.name: smarty_block_textformat
methods.description: Processes a text block with specified formatting options such as style, indentation, wrapping, and boundary settings; returns formatted text or assigns it to a Smarty variable.
